title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-018. Starting from a positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a massive C19 Klein-Gordon tangent, proves that a cubical four-component Dirac Hamiltonian squares to its continuum symbol, controls lattice and centered-time corrections, and derives the positive-frequency density/current limit from the same action and embeddings. It proves scoped copy exchange and a conditional cubical spin-one-half representation. Within a stated real, local, first-order, flavor-preserving cubical-incidence class, DIRAC-018 further classifies the continuum square root independently on both exact rank-four copies and proves the C19 scalar-symbol zero census. The result does not classify arbitrary nonlocal or flavor-mixing roots, construct an exact finite-spacing Dirac factorization, settle all fermion doubling, or prove a localized physical electron or electromagnetic coupling.
